answer: A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors as a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. The nectar record keeps the spread, ivory schedules the escalation, and ember publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 3 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 218 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
